description: Surface Optimization of the (001) Surface of Co (Hexagonal, P6_3/mmc) and Surface Energy Calculation
user_prompt: Optimize the (001) surface of cobalt Co (hexagonal, P6_3/mmc) and calculate the surface energy. Report the final surface energy in J/m^2.

references: Lin, Liu, Fan & Li, J. Phys. Chem. C 124, 11005 (2020)
method.modeling: hcp Co (P6_3/mmc), ferromagnetic, (001) basal plane; symmetric slab (>= 5-7 layers, converged), vacuum >= 15 A, surface relaxed.
method.rationale: Value 2.10 J/m^2 (= 131 meV/A^2) is the spin-polarized PBE Co(001) surface energy from Lin et al. 2020 (VASP, PAW-PBE, ferromagnetic). Co must be ferromagnetic (ISPIN=2); a nonmagnetic calculation gives the wrong lattice and surface energy. PBE underestimates the experimental ~2.55 J/m^2 (Tyson & Miller 1977), so the case is graded against the PBE value, not experiment. Tolerance +/-0.30 J/m^2 (absolute) covers PBE inter-setup scatter (slab thickness, k-mesh, pseudopotential); larger deviations usually signal an unconverged slab.
